contacts.title: Chief Executive Officer, Rasmala Investment Bank & Group CEO, Rasmala Holdings

description: DIFC-domiciled investment bank and asset manager (DFSA reference F000132, licensed 2005-12-13), part of the Rasmala group established 1999 — a leading alternative-investment firm investing directly and alongside Gulf-based banks, pension funds, endowments, family offices, corporations and government institutions. Licensed for advising, arranging, custody, dealing as agent/principal and managing assets across certificates, debentures, futures, options, shares, structured products, warrants and units, with an Islamic-window endorsement. Group AUM ~USD 1.5bn (2025); in October 2025 exited its Poseidon Fund at USD 500m, delivering an 8x+ return to shareholders. A separate DFSA-registered joint-venture entity, Rasmala CBD Asset Management Limited (with Commercial Bank of Dubai, est. 2007), also exists but was not added separately to avoid double-counting the same group.

fit.reasoning: Fit 60/60: priority segment investment bank/asset manager (20) + UAE (15) + genuinely multi-asset across listed instruments and alternatives (10) + manages third-party/institutional and family-office money by way of business (10) + DFSA-regulated (5). Trigger 20/25: Zak Hydari was appointed Senior Executive Officer of Rasmala Investment Bank in June 2024 having regained the Group CEO title, a genuine senior-leadership change (12) plus visible growth — USD 1.5bn group AUM in 2025 and an October 2025 USD 500m fund exit at 8x+ returns (8). Access 8/15: named, high-profile CEO (Zak Hydari, Forbes Middle East Top 50 Asset Managers 2026) — a real, reachable decision-maker though no warm intro. Total 88 — an established, well-known DIFC investment bank/asset manager with a recent leadership change and real momentum; worth working now, though as an established group it may already run mature systems — qualify further on incumbent stack before drafting outreach.
